new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager
new_roles.description:
Ready to join a global leader in air movement and ventilation? At Greenheck Group, joining our team means more than just starting a job, it’s joining an award-winning culture prioritizing your growth and development. Our unwavering commitment in supporting our team members both personally and professionally has earned us national recognition time and time again. As an innovative, environmentally responsible manufacturer of commercial HVAC systems, Greenheck Group designs and manufactures industry-leading air movement and ventilation solutions through our family of trusted brands. Our products are found in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities worldwide, from schools and hospitals to factories and stadiums. Since 1947, we’ve proudly invested in our people and our communities, fostering innovation, leadership, and opportunity at every level. We are more than products, we are a team of inspired people doing extraordinary things.

As a Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager for Greenheck Group you will own product strategy and delivery across Greenheck Group’s full manufacturing-systems portfolio — Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation. You will serve as the senior product leader for Manufacturing Execution Systems, directly leading the MES functional lead team, owning the roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, and establishing enterprise standards and consistency for manufacturing technology across Greenheck Group’s plants. You will operate as the critical connective link between enterprise manufacturing systems and the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the broader Operational Systems/CoE community.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Program Leadership: Own the product roadmap and delivery across the full manufacturing-systems portfolio — MES, maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation — across all Greenheck production sites. Lead the end-to-end roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, replacing legacy custom integrations and MII applications across Greenheck's production sites. Coordinate cross-functional teams, allocate resources, and co-manage project timelines with Program Management. Drive accountability throughout execution and establish aggressive, results-oriented goals for the team.
* Divisional & CoE Alignment: Serve as the critical point of alignment between enterprise MES capabilities and divisional/plant-level execution — partnering closely with the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the other Operational Systems/CoE groups (e.g., Operational Excellence, Machine Automation/MDC) to ensure enterprise standards translate into plant-level adoption and results.
* Team Leadership: Build and lead the MES functional lead team across the MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation domains.
* Change Leadership: Facilitate organizational change related to MES and manufacturing-systems adoption; communicate to create buy-in and promote system acceptance across plant floors.
* Standards and Consistency: Drive manufacturing-systems standards and consistency across Greenheck production sites through an MES steering committee and governance framework spanning MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation.

* Collaboration: Work closely with the Sr Manager, ERP and Program/Project Management on shared roadmap, resourcing, and delivery dependencies; partner with external resources to ensure manufacturing systems align with business objectives.

* 4-6 years of relevant work experience in MES implementation, project management or related fields required
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments required

* Strong team building and leadership

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations
new_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Manager Operations to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. This is an on-site position based in Santa Maria, CA. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to ensure the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This role drives operational performance through effective resource planning, workforce development, and process optimization while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partnering cross-functionally, the Senior Manager implements operational strategies, promotes accountability, and ensures efficient manufacturing execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

**Operational Leadership & Performance**

* Lead and oversee daily manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to achieve safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap reduction, and work-in-process (WIP) inventory objectives.
* Establish, monitor, and drive accountability for key operational performance indicators (KPIs), implementing corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, collaborating with relevant stakeholders, and implementing improvements within manufacturing operations.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Oversee all phases of manufacturing operations to ensure production activities comply with established procedures, quality standards, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Plan, coordinate, and optimize departmental activities, production schedules, and resource allocation to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Evaluate production capacity, workforce requirements, and operational constraints to ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, and manufacturing resources.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Lead, develop, and manage production and associated functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, and employee development to maintain operational readiness.
* Establish performance expectations, evaluate employee performance, and partner with Human Resources on coaching, employee relations, corrective actions, and performance management.

**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, AS9100 standards, applicable aerospace regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
* Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance by ensuring employees are appropriately trained and consistently follow established manufacturing procedures.

**Financial Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Manage departmental budgets, monitor operational expenditures, and implement cost-control measures to support financial objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, align production priorities, and meet customer delivery commitments.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education**:

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Associate degree, technical/trade certification, or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing production teams, operational performance, and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated success managing manufacturing operations in a complex, quality-driven production environment, with a focus on improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Proven ability to lead supervisors or managers, develop high-performing teams, and drive operational improvements across multiple manufacturing functions.

**Skills**:

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop teams, establish accountability, and manage employee performance.
* Proficiency in manufacturing operations, production planning, workforce allocation, and capacity management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational KPIs and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of budget management, cost control, and resource optimization within a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support business objectives.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft interiors, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, with knowledge of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and manufacturing performance reporting tools.

**Other**:

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.? Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to operational personnel to achieve organizational goals, operational performance objectives, and budgetary targets. Responsible for employee development, performance management, and building organizational capability.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and implement solutions to complex operational challenges that are consistent with organizational objectives and established business practices.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Salary Range Transparency:** $125,500 - $185,000

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture
* Potential for growth within organization

new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
new_roles.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

 **LEGAL STATEMENT**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. Employees have flexibility to choose the benefits that best fit their individual needs.

Health and wellbeing

* Medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
* LiveWell Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid time off and paid parental leave

Retirement and protection

* 401(k) with company match and Retirement Accumulation Plan cash balance pension plan
* Company provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and short term disability
* Voluntary employee and dependent life insurance, long term disability, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance

Additional benefits

* Commuter benefits
* Group legal and identity theft protection
* Auto and home insurance
* Pet insurance and discounts
* Back up child and elder care
* PerkSpot Employee Discount Program
* Volunteer Day

All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

new_roles.description:
We are the leading provider of worldwide smart end-to-end supply chain & logistics, enabling the flow of trade across the globe. Our comprehensive range of products and services covers every link of the integrated supply chain – from maritime and inland terminals to marine services and industrial parks as well as technology-driven customer solutions.

* Ensure that customer expectations are met and/or exceeded within the confines of company guidelines
* Quarterly presentations to customer senior management relative to our scorecard and initiatives
* Participate in customer invited meetings e.g. 9:30 am to support Customer strategic objectives
* Communicate with the customer and demonstrate initiatives supporting continuous improvement
* Meet company objectives with respect to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Morale and Environment
* Quarterly presentations to senior management of DP World re Plant objectives and initiatives
* Establish 5 year / contract life business plan, annual budgets and ensure targets are met
* Local initiatives to ensure plant progression in all regards

ADOPT CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT WITHIN THE WORKPLACE

* Plan and execute the concepts of lean manufacturing
* Ensure the plant plans and executes productivity tasks on an annual and ongoing basis
* Prioritize activities associated with the elimination of waste in all aspects of our operations

ORGANIZATIONAL STRENGTHENING

* Continue to build a stronger salaried team capable of leading the hourly workforce into the demands of the future
* Improve employee relations and morale through participation of personnel from the shop floor and instill behavioral discipline
* Improve communication throughout the organization and at all levels

NEW BUSINESS

* Work with the business development and account management group to identify business opportunities within the capabilities of the plant and local area
* Ensure the plant participates in all activities surrounding potential business and future profitability
* Ensure the plant is always in a state that maximizes its appeal to outsiders and potential customs

BE A CORPORATE CITIZEN, CREATE AN EXTERNAL IMAGE

* Ensure that DP World is a positive force within the community and considered to be a good employer
* Increase the exposure of DP World in a positive light to maximize our opportunity for future growth
* Work with other suppliers and industry focus groups in the local community to learn from their experiences and adapt accordingly

QUALITY & ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

* Participate as an active member of the management team in supporting ISO 14001 and ensuring that their direct reports abide by these processes and operating work instructions
* Drive, Attend and participate in both ISO TS 16949 and ISO 14001 management review

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* A college or university degree related to manufacturing is preferred and /or MBA
* At least seven years of progressively responsible operational leadership experience in logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or comparable environments, including at least three years managing managers or site leadership teams. Comparable relevant experience may be considered.
* Job experience in a Tier 1 operation is beneficial
* A production, materials and quality control background compliment skill set

***Please note****: This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in The United States without sponsorship now or in the future.*

**ABOUT DP WORLD**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

***WE MAKE TRADE FLOW***

***TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.***

DP World is committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief. 
 
By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize DP World to transmit and store your information in the world-wide recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.

new_roles.description:
Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.
 
 
**Job Details:** 
**Job Level:** 7
 
 
**Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:** 
Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 
 

* Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
* Health Savings Accounts w/company match
* FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
* FREE Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)
* Discounted & free product
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities for career advancement

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.
 
 
What does a Sr. Quality Manager do at Swire Coca-Cola?
 
Lead the Manufacturing Quality discipline at a manufacturing plant level to ensure that plant is operating to the Coca-Cola KORE standards and that all products produced maintain the highest standards of consumer quality for brand integrity.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, guide and measure the in-plant quality standards that must be met to manufacture products that meet all KO and industry standards for consumer consumption
* Hire, train, and mentor Quality Lab Technicians and Lab/Sanitation Supervisors at the plant level to ensure they are qualified to perform all the quality processes and procedures required to deliver quality product to consumers
* Guide the creation and maintenance of documentation, processes, and procedures to fully comply with all KO KORE standards requirements, as well as any other industry/regulatory requirements for quality in manufacturing at the plant level
* Establish and maintain strong associations with other Coca-Cola bottlers in the Quality Management space in order to effectively learn best practices, provide guidance/counsel where appropriate, and be aware of changing trends and requirements that must be implemented at the plants
* Proactively develop relationships with local and state government agencies responsible for managing water usage and quality standards, discharge standards, etc
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Requirements:** 

* High School Diploma (or GED) required and
* College degree preferred in chemistry, biology, preferred or related science field
* 4+ years' experience in Quality Management in a food manufacturing industry – soft drink preferred
* Strong understanding of the science of soft drink production at the base molecular level
* Strong knowledge of industry quality standards for manufacturing of food grade products
* Specific knowledge of all state and local standards and requirements for water quality and raw materials for food grade production
* KO KORE and ISO quality standards in a soft drink environment

Come and join our Sparkling team!
 
 
Due to the nature of our work and to help maintain a safe workplace for our employees and customers, after a candidate receives a conditional offer of employment, they will be required to complete pre-employment screening. This includes a criminal background check, drug screening, and for certain roles, a motor vehicle record review.
 
 
Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.
 
 
All results are reviewed fairly and in accordance with applicable state and federal laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
 
 
Swire Coca-Cola is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer that participates in the E-Verify program as required by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Swire Coca-Cola does not sponsor applicants for work visas.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C)
new_roles.description:
**About Hirsh Precision**
-------------------------

Hirsh Precision is a leader in U.S. manufacturing, bringing productivity and product innovation to medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific markets through software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern production systems. Our reputation for integrity, quality, service, and excellence is powered by a passionate, engaged team and a culture focused on work that improves people’s lives.

**Role Snapshot**
-----------------

As the Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C), you will orchestrate end-to-end planning operations that keep our factory synchronized—from MRP and buy planning to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. You’ll shape the planning strategy, lead a high-performing team, and ensure schedules, materials, and capacity align to deliver on time, every time.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own and execute MRP activities, including buy planning, material master data stewardship, warehousing, and logistics coordination.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align planning strategies to business goals.
* Lead continuous improvement to increase affordability while safeguarding performance and quality.
* Build, mentor, and develop a top-performing team through training, coaching, performance assessments, and recognition.
* Create and manage production schedules to optimize capacity utilization and meet on-time delivery commitments.
* Monitor shop orders, production priorities, and work center schedules, adjusting proactively as conditions change.
* Collaborate with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to anticipate and resolve material, labor, and equipment constraints.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all scheduling-related issues.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reporting, and overall efficiency via continuous improvement.
* Maintain pristine scheduling data integrity within BPCS and generate KPI dashboards, performance reports, and metrics.
* Provide senior-level insights and reporting to executive stakeholders.

### **A week in the role might look like**

* Kick off with an S&OP alignment touchpoint; validate demand signals and capacity models.
* Review MRP outputs; firm planned orders and buy plans; resolve exceptions with Purchasing.
* Walk the floor with Operations to assess bottlenecks; rebalance work center loads and update priorities.
* Host a cross-functional huddle with Engineering and Quality to mitigate risks on critical programs.
* Publish schedule health KPIs from BPCS and brief leaders on variances and corrective actions.
* Coach a planner on data-governance best practices; recognize wins in a team standup.

### **Basic qualifications**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM)

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* At least 3 years leading multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical proficiency**

* Hands-on with mid- and upper-tier ERP systems
* Strong analytical capability, KPI dashboard development, and data-governance expertise

#### **Leadership competencies**

* Clear, influential communicator with stakeholder management strength
* Demonstrated talent development and mentorship capability

#### **Other core skills**

* Data-driven problem solving
* Change management expertise
* Continuous-improvement mindset

#### **Desired skills**

* Strategic execution—able to think long-term while delivering hands-on results
* Mentorship & team building—coaching, developing high-performing teams, and succession planning
* Business acumen—translate data into actionable insights that drive cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrix environments; foster cross-functional partnerships and knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—champion new tools, processes, and best practices that elevate PP&C performance

### **Tools you’ll use**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (including BPCS for scheduling data integrity and reporting)

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management — AI Quality & Evaluation
new_roles.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.
* Evidence of coaching and mentoring colleagues without relying on reporting authority, and the ability to deliver independently in a fast-moving environment.
Clear communication with customers, technical teams, and senior leaders, including an honest account of what is known, uncertain, or still unproven. 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Evaluation platforms, agent systems, AI observability, retrieval, or enterprise AI products.
* Building in an AI-native startup or entrepreneurial environment, taking a new product from early customer learning to adoption, and applying lessons from both successful and unsuccessful experiments.
* Hands-on prototyping with coding agents and delivery of customer-facing performance or outcome experiences.
Leading initiatives that require agreement across research, engineering, product, and customer-facing organizations. 

What success looks like
 
 
Customers see credible improvement in real agent workflows, supported by evaluations they can trust. You independently take an initial quality problem from failure analysis through experimentation and customer validation, and deliver a focused feature with engineering. Teams make better release and investment decisions because of the evidence, product judgment, and coaching you bring.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off

* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Ops Excellence and Resiliency to build and lead the process improvement, operational resilience, and AI transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role will turn findings and opportunities identified through Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, incidents, and operational performance into redesigned workflows, stronger operating models, and scalable transformation roadmaps. The Senior Manager will bring a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify and standardize how work gets done, identify critical dependencies and failure points, strengthen contingency and readiness practices, and develop an AI transformation roadmap that rethinks how Risk Operations can operate—not simply make today’s manual steps faster. The role will partner across Risk Operations and with Product, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders to move validated opportunities from insight to sustainable operational change.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build the Ops Excellence and Resiliency capability for Risk Operations, creating an integrated approach to process improvement, operational resilience, and technology-enabled transformation.
* Translate findings from Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, root cause analysis, incidents, and operational performance into a prioritized portfolio of process, resilience, automation, and AI transformation opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign by applying a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify, standardize, and optimize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary manual work, inefficient handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* Build an operational resilience model by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs across Risk Operations.
* Develop dependency maps, contingency playbooks, and operational readiness practices in partnership with process owners to help critical incident and safety response capabilities continue through disruption.
* Develop and maintain the AI transformation roadmap for Risk Operations, identifying where AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, reporting, and other workflows rather than simply automate individual manual steps.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on operational value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment to business needs, and translate validated opportunities into pilots and delivery roadmaps with Product and Technology partners.
* Partner with Incident Management, Safety, Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to redesign workflows and implement sustainable improvements across organizational boundaries.
* Establish measures of success for transformation and resilience efforts, including cycle-time reduction, handoffs eliminated, process consistency, adoption, resilience readiness, recovery performance, and realized benefits from automation and AI-enabled changes.
* Create clear executive reporting and recommendations that show the improvement portfolio, resilience risks and readiness, AI transformation opportunities, implementation progress, dependencies, decisions required, and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in operational excellence, process engineering, continuous improvement, operational resilience, business continuity, technology transformation, program management, risk operations, or related fields.
* 3+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional initiatives in high-volume or operationally complex environments.
* Demonstrated experience redesigning and simplifying end-to-end operational processes, with the ability to translate findings and pain points into scalable future-state workflows.
* Strong process engineering and structured problem-solving capabilities, with experience identifying root causes, dependencies, failure points, and opportunities to reduce manual work and inefficient handoffs.
* Experience building or supporting operational resilience, business continuity, contingency planning, dependency mapping, or operational readiness programs.
* Experience developing and executing transformation roadmaps involving technology, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operations, including the ability to distinguish incremental automation from broader operating-model transformation.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills with the ability to synthesize monitoring findings, risk intelligence, operational metrics, and stakeholder input into prioritized improvement opportunities and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, program leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to partner across Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk Operations, and other cross-functional teams to move ideas from identification through implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in last-mile delivery, gig economy platforms, marketplaces, trust & safety, transportation, retail, e-commerce, investigations, fraud/risk operations, or other high-volume decision environments.
* Familiarity with TPM, Lean/Six Sigma, process engineering, systems thinking, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience designing business continuity or operational resilience frameworks, including dependency mapping, contingency playbooks, readiness exercises, or recovery planning.
* Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing AI and automation opportunities within complex operational workflows, including development of opportunity roadmaps, pilots, or business cases.
* Experience partnering with monitoring, assurance, risk intelligence, product, engineering, and analytics teams to convert operational findings and emerging risks into sustainable process and technology improvements.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Location:** Alhambra, CA (Onsite)

 

**Our Team**

SPP is a vertically integrated photonics business focused on the design, fabrication, and delivery of Indium Phosphide (InP) semiconductor laser and gain chips. SPP operates two wafer fabrication facilities in Southern California supporting advanced photonic devices and customer die demand.

 

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering serves as the senior quality leader within SPP Operations and is responsible for building and leading the manufacturing quality organization across both fabrication facilities. The role establishes quality systems, inspection practices, quality metrics, and quality culture while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, and the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering to support business growth and manufacturing excellence.

This position provides leadership for manufacturing quality strategy, execution, and organizational development across both fabrication facilities and is expected to maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor. The role supports Epitaxial Growth, Wafer Fabrication, Bar Processing, Chip Processing, and Test Operations, and works closely with Epitaxy, Process, Product, and Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Test Operations, and Reliability & Failure Analysis.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the SPP Fab Quality organization across both fabrication facilities
* Recruit, develop, and manage quality inspectors while building future technician and quality engineering capabilities
* Establish quality procedures, metrics, escalation processes, reporting systems, and a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement.
* Establish incoming inspection processes, acceptance criteria, and material-control procedures for critical materials including III-V substrates, epitaxial source materials, specialty gases, precious metals, process chemicals, and optical and test consumables
* Verify material certifications; establish supplier qualification, monitoring, corrective-action, and containment processes
* Ensure traceability and disposition tracking.
* Develop and implement in-process quality control systems, containment and escalation processes for quality excursions, and process controls across manufacturing operations
* Monitor process performance and quality trends
* Drive reduction of defects, scrap, rework, and quality escapes; and ensure consistent quality practices across both fabs.
* Implement and maintain manufacturing quality systems, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), CAPA, Non-Conforming Material Report (NCMR) processes, FMEA, and process control plans
* Provide independent quality review and approval of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), process changes, and manufacturing transfers
* Establish and maintain ESD control programs and quality documentation and records.
* Lead investigations of manufacturing quality excursions and process escapes in partnership with Process Engineering and Product Engineering
* Monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk)
* Provide quality leadership for measurement-system capability and MSA activities
* Support tool and process qualification and requalification
* Use quality data to improve process stability, defect reduction, and yield.
* Maintain audit readiness across both fabrication facilities
* Support internal, customer, and ISO audits
* Support contamination-control initiatives and cleanroom environmental monitoring
* Ensure quality documentation meets compliance requirements
* Partner with the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering on corporate quality initiatives and enterprise quality alignment.
Other relevant tasks, as assigned. 

 
 

**Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience: 7+ years of manufacturing quality experience within wafer fabrication, photonics, compound semiconductor, or related advanced manufacturing environments
* Leadership: 3+ years of people leadership experience
* Strong knowledge of SPC, CAPA, NCMR, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and manufacturing quality systems
* Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective-action programs
* Experience supporting semiconductor wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Experience working effectively across Operations and Engineering functions 

 

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in wafer-fab quality within silicon semiconductor, compound semiconductor, photonics, III-V semiconductor, optoelectronics, or optical communications manufacturing environments
* Experience supporting epitaxial growth operations
* Experience building or scaling manufacturing quality organizations within multi-site manufacturing environments
* Experience with supplier-quality programs and semiconductor MES systems
* Comfortable operating in evolving, high-mix manufacturing environments with limited historical data
Desire to learn InP epitaxial growth, wafer fabrication, and photonics manufacturing technologies 

 

The intent of this job description is to describe the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. Incumbents may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically included in this description.

 

All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

We are proud to be an EEO employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace.

 

A reasonable estimate of the pay range for this position is $130,000 - $180,000. There are several factors taken into consideration in determining base salary, including but not limited to: job-related qualifications, skills, education and experience, as well as job location and the value of other elements of an employee’s total compensation package.
